data.description:
The deployed landing page (src/routes/landing.route.tsx) offers exactly four doors: /f/cfp, /portal?demo=speaker, /reviewer?demo=reviewer, /submissions?demo=organizer — plus a link to https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee, which returns 404 to everyone outside the org.

TWO DEFECTS, ONE FILE:

1. THE PUBLIC SEAT HAS NO DOOR. /agenda (65KB of real server-rendered sessions) and /speakers (25KB) are live, anonymous and healthy, and nothing on the landing page links to either. Same failure class as the reviewer-seat-with-no-door that cost ~24.7 eval points. Public Widgets carries area_weight 20, and a scenario agent that never reaches a surface scores cannot_judge, which drags toward the 60% coverage cliff where the headline score is WITHHELD ENTIRELY.

2. THE OPEN-SOURCE LINK IS A DEAD END. The competition requires an open-source repo. Verified: curl -sIL https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee -> 404.

SCOPE: add discoverable doors to /agenda and /speakers in the same visual language as the existing four (Flight Deck per DESIGN.md; elements never jump). Do NOT change the GitHub URL here — publication is an operator decision tracked separately. If it has not resolved when this is ready, leave the link untouched and say so in the PR.

VERIFY AFTER DEPLOY: curl -s https://marquee.stage11.dev/ | grep -oE 'href=.[^"]*.' must include /agenda and /speakers.

Evidence: sequence/research/DIFFERENTIATION-MATRIX.md, Live defects D0 and D4.
data.title: The landing page hides the public conference and links to a 404

data.body: SCOPE NOTE from the ticket author: the GitHub-link half of this ticket is now MOOT and must not be touched. Atin ruled the public artifact is this repo itself, flipping public at ~21:30 ET; Submission Prep (workspace:5 surface:26) owns it. The 404 resolves itself. Your scope is the /agenda and /speakers doors ONLY — which stands unchanged and is still the critical half.

Implementation checkpoint pushed at 917223df. src/routes/landing.route.tsx adds /agenda and /speakers as existing ghost buttons; the GitHub URL is unchanged. Local seeded Worker proof on :8877: root 9,917 B with both hrefs, /agenda 136,561 B titled Agenda · Marquee with session markers, /speakers 86,962 B titled Speakers · Marquee with speaker markers. Full baseline npm test timed out at 600,339 ms under fleet load after unrelated Resend/queue failures; scoped validation and pr-gate remain.

PR #121 is open at https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/121 from exact head 917223df22fe2f6cb040dd6648050b0e17550c23; remote branch matches. Local anonymous SSR proof is attached: root 9,917 B includes /agenda and /speakers, /agenda 136,561 B with Agenda and session-title markers, /speakers 86,962 B with Speakers and speaker-directory markers. Static PR-gate checks passed; hermetic suite timed out at 600383 ms versus 45000 ms under fleet load and missing RESEND_API_KEY, so it is reported as a gate failure. GitHub CI fast-gate is in progress. Automatic Lattice code-review hook remains pending. GitHub URL was left unchanged and no deployment was performed; awaiting human review, merge, and deploy.

Post-restart audit: PR #121 merged as cd222521 (fast-gate green, merged by BenevolentFutures 20:46Z). The assigned agent died in the c11 restart after the merge landed but before updating this ticket. Verified live: deployed build acc19c8a includes cd222521, and https://marquee.stage11.dev/ now serves hrefs to /agenda and /speakers — the ticket's verify-after-deploy criterion passes. GitHub-link half remains out of scope per DiffAnalyst-1's scope note. Closing as done.

Post-merge code review (the auto-review agent died in the c11 restart; no review had landed on PR #121, so I read the diff myself — I am not the author). Diff is two lines in src/routes/landing.route.tsx: anchors to /agenda and /speakers using the same 'button ghost' class as the existing /f/cfp door — consistent Flight Deck visual language, appended inside the existing hero button container, no layout shift on state change. Both targets verified sound: they are SSR routes mounted before app.all('*') and both are in app.tsx's isPublicPage list, so the client entry will not mount the admin shell over them. Live check: /agenda 200/136,562B (80 session mentions), /speakers 200/86,963B. No concerns; approve post-merge.
